title: DOptDRPSNN-EMS: reproducibility package for IoT-enabled smart building energy management with integrated load forecasting, anomaly detection and control
description: Executable reproducibility package accompanying the paper. Contains the synthetic DOE-reference-inspired benchmark, leakage-controlled split definitions, the frozen canonical configuration, executable scripts for forecasting, ablation, ten-seed encoder-matched stability, anomaly calibration and supervisory-control experiments, and the exact raw per-seed outputs used to construct every reported mean and standard deviation.
